tools.name: propertymeld_list_melds
tools.description: List Property Meld work orders (called melds) with status, property, unit and dates. Filter by status, e.g. open, pending_completion, completed or canceled. Property Meld API: GET /api/v2/meld/.

tools.name: propertymeld_get_meld
tools.description: Get one Property Meld work order (meld) by id: status, description, property, unit, assigned vendor and scheduled times. Property Meld API: GET /api/v2/meld/{id}/.

tools.name: propertymeld_list_properties
tools.description: List the properties in the Property Meld account, with addresses. Property Meld API: GET /api/v2/property/.

tools.name: propertymeld_list_vendors
tools.description: List the vendors (contractors) in the Property Meld account, with contact details and trades. Property Meld API: GET /api/v2/vendor/.
